text: Which option correctly matches each temporal ontology to what it says exists?
choices: Presentism: all times exist; Eternalism: only the present exists; Growing block: past and present exist.
Presentism: past and present exist; Eternalism: only the present exists; Growing block: all times exist.
Presentism: present and future exist; Eternalism: only the present exists; Growing block: only the past exists.
Presentism: only the present exists; Eternalism: all times (past, present, future) exist equally; Growing block: the past and present exist, but not the future.
explanation: Presentism holds only the present is real; eternalism (the block universe) holds past, present, and future are equally real; the growing block holds the past and present exist while the future does not yet. Option 0 swaps presentism and eternalism, which is the most common confusion in this area.
